_comment: Outlets the Scraper reads, as data so adding one is a config edit.
Feed URLs only — the Scraper does not crawl article pages (issue #1,
story 21: respect robots.txt and rate limits). Issue #1 names FMT, Malay
Mail, NST, The Star, The Vibes, Sinar Daily and Bernama; only outlets
whose feed has been verified to work are listed here.
Two of the seven are absent, each for its own reason (issue #11).
Re-check before assuming either is still true:
- The Star: no working feed. Its own RSS directory page at
/news/nation/rss advertises ~30 feeds, and every one of them returns
404 — the directory is stale, not our request. Verified not to be
User-Agent dependent: a browser Agent gets the same 404.
- Sinar Daily: robots.txt disallows /rss and /rssFeed/* for every Agent
but Facebook's. Story 21 says we respect that, so there is nothing to
do here unless they change the rules.
Bernama is present but dates nothing: no item in its feed carries a
pubDate, so every Bernama Article has published_at = None. That is
recorded honestly rather than guessed (issue #11). Nothing reads
published_at today; anything that starts to must handle None.
